tooltip_definitions.Total GAAP Revenue: Consolidated GAAP net revenue from automotive 4D LiDAR and industrial FMCW sensing solutions ($6.67M in Q3 2026, up +86.3% YoY from $3.58M in Q3 2025).
tooltip_definitions.Automotive & Trucking Sensing Revenue: Revenue derived from commercial vehicle programs including Daimler Truck production series and Bendix market-leading ADAS integration ($4.55M in Q3 2026).
tooltip_definitions.Industrial & Optical Connectivity Revenu: Revenue from high-power optical source modules for AI data centers and Micro-Epsilon / SICK factory automation sensors ($2.12M in Q3 2026).
tooltip_definitions.Gross Margin: GAAP gross margin of 33.58% in Q3 2026 ($2.24M gross profit on $6.67M revenue), significantly higher than 12.01% in Q3 2025.
tooltip_definitions.Operating Loss: GAAP operating loss of -$39.11M in Q3 2026, reflecting continued R&D investment ($28.87M) and G&A scaling ($10.85M) for OEM series production.
tooltip_definitions.GAAP Diluted EPS: GAAP diluted net loss per share of -$0.54 in Q3 2026 based on weighted-average shares outstanding.
tooltip_definitions.Operating Cash Flow: Cash used in operating activities of -$30.37M in Q3 2026, an improvement from -$31.17M in Q2 2026.
tooltip_definitions.True Free Cash Flow: Economic cash generation deducting CapEx ($0.0M) and non-cash SBC ($11.41M) from OCF (-$30.37M), yielding -$41.78M in Q3 2026.
tooltip_definitions.Total Available Liquidity: Cash, cash equivalents, marketable securities and available credit totaling $272.5M as of September 30, 2026, providing over two years of runway.
tooltip_definitions.Frequency Modulated Continuous Wave (FMC: Aeva's core technology utilizing continuous laser beams to instantaneously measure radial velocity and range per pixel with zero optical crosstalk.
tooltip_definitions.Aeva Atlas 4D LiDAR: Automotive-grade 4D LiDAR sensing engine featuring silicon photonics integration designed for passenger car and commercial truck automated driving.
tooltip_definitions.Daimler Truck Series Production: Milestone production development contract for heavy-duty autonomous Class 8 trucks with series production scheduled for 2027.
tooltip_definitions.Micro-Epsilon Supply Agreement: Multi-year commercial supply contract for precision factory automation sensors with initial multi-thousand unit order received in Q3 2026.
tooltip_definitions.US Defense Autonomy Contract: Selection by the US Air Force and US Navy to develop airborne autonomy capabilities utilizing Aeva's FMCW velocity sensing.
tooltip_definitions.AI Optical Connectivity: Proprietary ultra-high-power optical laser engines addressing high-density optical interconnects for next-generation AI data centers.
tooltip_definitions.Silicon Photonics Engine: Chip-scale optical processing hardware consolidating laser transmitters, optical receivers, and processing on a single semiconductor chip.
tooltip_definitions.Stock-Based Compensation: Non-cash equity incentives totaling $11.41M in Q3 2026, up from $8.51M in Q2 2026.
tooltip_definitions.Bendix ADAS Collaboration: Joint commercial development with Bendix to integrate Aeva's 4D LiDAR into market-leading commercial vehicle ADAS suites.
